# Sunbather

Sunbather is a minimal pink theme whose stated inspiration is the vim-sunbather colour scheme. Soft pastels and subtle contrasts are used for a calm, distraction-free interface for writing and reading notes.

![Sunbather screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/babidisrc/obsidian-sunbather/HEAD/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Sunbather"
    author: "babidisrc"
    repo:   "babidisrc/obsidian-sunbather"
    slug:   "sunbather"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/sunbather"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/babidisrc/obsidian-sunbather"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/babidisrc/obsidian-sunbather/HEAD/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a minimal pink aesthetic inspired by the vim-sunbather color scheme. Use soft pastels and subtle contrasts to create a calm, distraction-free interface for writing and reading notes."
}
```
